input.quote: Company agrees to retain Contractor to perform the consulting services for Company, on a task by task basis (the "Services"), and Contractor agrees to furnish the Services on the terms and subject to the conditions set forth in this Agreement.
input.rationale: No exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation binds Clear Capital. The engagement is expressly "on a task by task basis" through individual Statements of Work (p0004), compensation is time-and-materials with no minimum volume or requirements commitment (p0013), and there is no language requiring Company to purchase all or any share of its requirements from Contractor or barring it from procuring similar services from third parties (searches for "exclusive", "sole supplier/provider", "requirements", "competing", "non-compete" returned no such covenant). The only "sole and exclusive" references are Contractor's ownership of its pre-existing property (p0020) and the standard non-exclusive license and entire-agreement clauses (p0021, p0051), which are IP/boilerplate rather than exclusive dealing. The mutual non-solicitation of employees (p0047) is a personnel restriction, not a restriction on sourcing services. Our freedom to buy from other suppliers is preserved, so no redline is needed.
